unit: seconds of pytest setup, call and teardown, summed per test file
basis: mean over the runs below of each file's summed junit test time
suite_test_seconds: 573 to 833 across the four runs, 718 in the mean record
planner: the 'Plan this shard's hooks test files (OMN-19681)' step of the hooks-tests job in .github/workflows/ci.yml
refresh: gh run download <run-id> -p 'hooks-test-results-*' -D <dir>; sum each junit testcase's time by its test file (the classname's module path, tests.hooks.test_x.TestY -> tests/hooks/test_x.py), average over runs and write {file: seconds} to config/hooks_test_file_durations.json

local_additions.basis: sum of testcase time in local h200 junit report
